lines.trans: I managed to hire a coordinator in Hawaii for cheap.
Apparently he'll negotiate the actress's appearance for us too.
Really? Then we have to make it a major production.
Please don't ask where the money came from.
Thank you very much, Mr. Kawada.

words.t: ありがとうございます
words.reading: アリガトウゴザイマス

lines.trans: This is the last time I indulge your selfishness.
Hey, you guys aren't going over there to play around.
If you shoot something boring, I won't forgive you.
Yeah, leave it to me.
Mr. Muranishi, please take every care with this.
Yes, off I go. Let's move!
I'm counting on you guys for a comeback home run!

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

examples.text: ハワイのコーディネーター安く雇えたからよ。
examples.trans: I managed to hire a coordinator in Hawaii for cheap.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

examples.text: ハワイのコーディネーター安く雇えたからよ。
examples.trans: I managed to hire a coordinator in Hawaii for cheap.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

examples.text: 女優の出演も交渉してくれるらしいぞ。
examples.trans: Apparently he'll negotiate the actress's appearance for us too.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.

meanings.en: do a favor for the speaker
meanings.note: After a te-form (会ってくれる？), warmly asks 'will you do that for us?'

examples.trans: Will you come again for me?

examples.text: 母が料理を作ってくれました。
examples.trans: My mother cooked food for me.

meanings.note: Evidential auxiliary adjective expressing hearsay or inference.

examples.text: 百万冊以上売れてるらしい。
examples.trans: Apparently it sells over a million copies.

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.

examples.text: 出どころは聞かないでください。
examples.trans: Please don't ask where the money came from.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
Follows a verb's て-form or polite お + stem (お待ちください, お持ち帰りください) to make a polite request.

examples.text: ここに書いてください。

meanings.note: Attached to surnames, given names, or company names to show everyday respect; never used for oneself.
Standalone casual thanks; followed by ございます (present) or ございました (completed occasion) for polite thanks.

examples.text: ありがとうございます。
わがままを聞くのは今回で最後ですから。
examples.trans: This is the last time I indulge your selfishness.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.note: Blunt or rowdy second-person pronoun used with subordinates, rivals, or close crew.

examples.trans: I leave it to you guys.

meanings.note: Attaches to pronouns or people nouns (僕ら, 彼ら).

examples.text: おい、お前ら遊びに行くんじゃねえからな。
examples.trans: Hey, you guys aren't going over there to play around.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Polite/dialectal negative ending, especially in ～ません.
Attaches to a past-stem verb form to set up a condition ('if a fire starts').

examples.text: 火事になったら大変です。
examples.trans: If a fire breaks out, it will be terrible.

examples.text: 家に帰ったら電話します。
examples.trans: I will call when I get home.

meanings.note: Signals recognizing someone ('Oh, Toshi!') or letting out a feeling ('Man, I'm hungry').

おく.gloss: do in advance; keep in state

meanings.note: After a te-form (積んでおきました, contracted 入っとけ), indicates doing something in advance or staying put.

examples.text: 窓を開けておきました。
ここに置いておきます。
examples.trans: I will leave it here for now.

examples.text: 村西さん、くれぐれもよろしくお願いします。
examples.trans: Mr. Muranishi, please take every care with this.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Core adverb in set greetings like よろしくお願いします and どうぞよろしく.
With します, forms お願いします ('please'), the standard polite way to request a service or favor.

examples.text: 一つお願いがあります。
examples.trans: I have one favor to ask.

meanings.note: Used both to answer yes politely and when handing an item to someone.

examples.text: はい、いってきます。行くぞ！
examples.trans: Yes, off I go. Let's move!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

examples.text: お前ら、一発逆転ホームラン頼んだぞ！
examples.trans: I'm counting on you guys for a comeback home run!

examples.text: これね、一発逆転ホームランになるかも。
examples.trans: This might really turn into that comeback home run.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Contracts では; launches a decision ('well then') or opens casual farewell じゃあね.
Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
